title: Tracer normalized trajectory (v1)
description: The published contract between the normalizer and its consumers. A single trajectory is one document. Large trajectories are stored in the sharded layout (see $defs.summary + $defs.chunk); concatenating a summary's meta/totals/parse/links with the events from its chunks in index order must reproduce a document valid against this top-level schema.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version. A consumer MUST refuse a document whose version it does not implement.

parentEventIndex.description: Index of the event in the PARENT that spawned this trajectory. Present only when both documents were normalized together, since that is the only point at which the position is knowable. Absent for a root, for a child exported without its parent, and in documents written before R59.

autoTitle.description: Derived fallback name (first user message, truncated); title stays authored-only

provider.description: Serving host, captured only where the transcript names one: codex session_meta.model_provider, opencode message providerID (verbatim). ABSENT for claude — the transcript does not name a host — and absent when opencode messages disagree.

speed.description: Anthropic serving speed from message.usage.speed, recorded verbatim (e.g. 'standard'). ABSENT when unrecorded.

inferenceGeo.description: Anthropic inference geo from message.usage.inference_geo, only when it is a real geo. The literal 'not_available' is the source saying it does not know and is captured as absence.

mode.description: Session mode reported by the CLI (e.g. normal).

permissionMode.description: Permission mode reported by the CLI (e.g. default).

input.description: Uncached input tokens, SAME meaning for every source: tokens billed at the base input rate, DISJOINT from cacheRead and cacheWrite. Sources whose raw usage reports cache-inclusive input (codex: cache reads and writes are subsets of input_tokens) are normalized by the adapter; the raw figure is recoverable as input + cacheRead + cacheWrite. Sources whose cache accounting is unknown (see pricing cachedIncludedInInput: null) pass through as reported and refuse cost estimates when cache tokens are present.

cacheRead.description: Input tokens served from cache. Disjoint from input for every source.

cacheWrite.description: Total cache-write tokens. Unchanged meaning; cacheWrite5m + cacheWrite1h when the split is present.

cacheWrite5m.description: Anthropic 5-minute-TTL cache writes. ABSENT when the source reports no TTL split — absent is not zero.

cacheWrite1h.description: Anthropic 1-hour-TTL cache writes (billed 2x base input). ABSENT when the source reports no TTL split.

reasoning.description: Reasoning/thinking tokens AS METERED BY THE PROVIDER — semantics are per-source. codex/OpenAI: real count; the thinking EVENTS are content-empty (encrypted upstream). opencode/Fireworks: count when the host meters it, else 0 even when visible thinking text exists. claude/Anthropic: always 0 — thinking tokens are folded into output and no split exists. Therefore reasoning=0 does NOT mean no thinking, and empty thinking events do NOT mean no thinking.

cost.description: Every cost figure for a trajectory, kept apart by where it came from (SPEC section 9). Each member is absent when its source is, and none stands in for another. A consumer shows a reported figure where one covers the trajectory, and otherwise the estimate, marked as one.

reported.description: Each figure the CLI stated for a span of work, in the order found.

reportedByEvents.description: The sum of the events' reportedCostUSD. It covers the whole trajectory only when events equals of.

of.description: Events carrying token usage, which a complete sum would all have priced.

estimated.description: tracer's own figure from its price table and the trajectory's token totals, made the same way for every CLI. Absent when the model or its rates are not in the table.

reportedCost.description: A cost the CLI itself stated for a span of work. It is the CLI's own figure from its own price table, not a bill.

covers.description: trajectory: this trajectory alone. tree: this trajectory and every sub-agent under it, which a total counts once for the whole tree.

byModel.description: The same figure broken down by model, sorted by model name, when the CLI breaks it down.

incomplete.description: The CLI says some usage could not be priced and is left out of usd.

time.description: How long a trajectory was open, how much of that the agent sat idle, and how much its events account for as work (SPEC R77). What elapsedMs holds beyond idleMs and workMs is neither, and is left visible rather than folded into either.

elapsedMs.description: From the first timestamped event to the last. How long the trajectory was open, not how long anything took. Absent when fewer than two events carry a timestamp.

idleMs.description: The sum of the events' idleMs: time the agent waited for its next instruction.

workMs.description: The union of the events' workMs intervals. A union, not a sum, because tool calls running at once overlap.

reported.description: Each set of durations the CLI stated itself, kept beside tracer's figures and never in place of them.

reportedTime.description: Durations the CLI itself stated for a span of work. They follow the CLI's process, which may run on while nothing is written to the transcript.

covers.description: trajectory: this trajectory alone. tree: this trajectory and every sub-agent under it.

modelMs.description: Time spent waiting on the model, retries included.

modelMsWithoutRetries.description: Time spent waiting on the model, retries left out.

input.description: Per-event share of totals.input — same uncached, cache-disjoint semantics (see totals.input).

cacheWrite5m.description: Anthropic 5-minute-TTL share of cacheWrite. ABSENT when the source reports no split.

cacheWrite1h.description: Anthropic 1-hour-TTL share of cacheWrite. ABSENT when the source reports no split.

ts.description: ISO-8601; may be absent on meta events.

isError.description: The event itself failed, for events that have no result of their own. A tool call reports failure through result.isError; a turn that a provider error ended reports it here. Additive and optional: documents written before it omit it.

synthetic.description: The CLI wrote this reply itself without calling a model, as Claude Code does for an API error or after a local command. Such a reply carries no workMs. Additive and optional: documents written before it omit it.

idleMs.description: Milliseconds the agent spent waiting for its next instruction, from this event until work resumes at a user instruction, an assistant message, a thinking step or a tool call. A record carrying no work does not end the wait. Present only on an event that ends a turn, and absent when no work follows it. A long gap after a tool call is a slow tool, which is work, not idle. Additive and optional: documents written before it omit it.

workMs.description: Milliseconds of work this event accounts for, from the end of the previous piece of work to the end of this one. A tool call ends when its result arrives, so the figure covers issuing the call and running it. The model's latency before a reply lands on that reply, and records carrying no work are stepped over. Present only on a thinking step, an assistant message or a tool call, and absent when no earlier work bounds it. Additive and optional: documents written before it omit it.

reportedCostUSD.description: The cost in US dollars the CLI itself stated for this step, when it states one. A figure the CLI computed from its own price table, not a bill.

rawType.description: For fail-soft meta events: the original unrecognized record/part type.

childSessionId.description: Join key to the child trajectory.

adapterVersion.description: Adapter version, independent of CLI version.

cliVersionRange.description: CLI version range the adapter's fixtures cover.

unrecognized.description: Count of records that became fail-soft meta events.

unreadable.description: Lines that could not be read as JSON — a damaged file — as opposed to `unrecognized`, which counts valid records whose type no adapter knows. Optional: documents written before R56 omit it.

skippedByType.description: Records that produced no event, counted per record type and SORTED by type. Sorted, and an array rather than an object, because object key order would be data-dependent and this output is compared byte for byte.

type.description: Source record type; '(no type)' when the record carries none.

stripEntry.description: One compact entry per event in summary.json — a few bytes each so a 50k summary stays small. Positional fields mirror the event at the same index.

turnEnd.description: Render a turn-boundary tick before/at this event.

idleMs.description: Milliseconds the agent spent waiting for its next instruction, from this event until work resumes at a user instruction, an assistant message, a thinking step or a tool call. A record carrying no work does not end the wait. Present only on an event that ends a turn, and absent when no work follows it. A long gap after a tool call is a slow tool, which is work, not idle. Additive and optional: documents written before it omit it.

workMs.description: Milliseconds of work this event accounts for, from the end of the previous piece of work to the end of this one. A tool call ends when its result arrives, so the figure covers issuing the call and running it. The model's latency before a reply lands on that reply, and records carrying no work are stepped over. Present only on a thinking step, an assistant message or a tool call, and absent when no earlier work bounds it. Additive and optional: documents written before it omit it.

redacted.description: True when thinking text is unavailable at source; render a non-color-only marker.

size.description: Rough byte-size hint for the full event.

label.description: Optional short label (e.g. tool name) for tooltip/index.

summary.description: summary.json — everything the index page and strip need, without any chunk fetch.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version. A consumer MUST refuse a document whose version it does not implement.

chunk.description: chunks/NNN.json — full events for a fixed index range. Chunk N holds events N*chunkSize .. N*chunkSize+chunkSize-1.

index.description: index.json at the cache root — the set of trajectories for the input, enough to render the index page from summaries.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version. A consumer MUST refuse a document whose version it does not implement.

id.description: Trajectory id (sessionId or a stable slug).

path.description: Directory (relative to cache root) holding summary.json + chunks/.
